title: M2 (CH264) J2 window close (MEASUREMENT_M2_CH264.md 9.3): at END_UTC + 6 h write the unit manifest (sha256 of every unit, no_favourite and status file, slot coverage over the 252 slots, missing-capture list); the unit set is closed after it
expected_value: the manifest sha256 that the ledger records and that the analysis verifies (void 11.7 otherwise)
next_action: commit manifest_sha256 to the ledger and into the pins file (docs/research_lab/seals/M2_pins.json) before the analysis; then q0755c_m2_j2_followup after the read-out
notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/). The last window slot (grid 2026-12-14T22:31Z) is decided from grid + 6 h = 2026-12-15T04:31Z, so the 04:50Z J1 pass decides it; END_UTC + 6 h is 06:00Z; not_before 06:30Z. J2 refuses unless every one of the 252 window slots has a chain status (processed or its own missing_capture status) and the state-file sha256 chain verifies (void case 11.2(a) otherwise). Write-once; an identical re-run is accepted. The 06:50Z J1 pass may add post-window status files; the manifest lists only the files that exist when it is written, and the analysis checks those. Code: backend/scripts/run_m2.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m2_spec.py, m2_j1.py, m2_j2.py, m2_readout.py, m2_analysis.py (code_sha in the unit lines); pins checked at start (exit 3 with expected and actual values on a mismatch, exit 2 on a declared refusal).
